verdict.rationale: The only openness evidence is a public GitHub repo (coinbase/cdp-sdk) with client libraries for EVM and Solana wallets, so some client-side source is readable. The core Payments service is hosted and custodial, and nothing shows its source is published or what license the SDK uses. missing for 10: evidence of an open-source license (e.g. MIT or Apache) on the SDK, published source for the payments backend or service itself, and independent corroboration of openness.
